prompt: Single continuous shot, no cuts. Two coffee cups on the counter, late-afternoon light. The fridge opens without hesitation, a hand pulling three ingredients in one confident sweep. The camera follows pasta hitting a hot pan with bursting cherry tomatoes, tossed high, olive oil catching the backlight in a golden arc. Money shot: the pasta tossed with the blistered tomatoes and torn basil, glossy strands lifting in macro, steam glowing. Final beat: two bowls set right on the counter, informal, two forks twirling side by side. Warm dusk light, deep shadows, film grain. Dominant sound: the tomato pops, then the pan toss. No speech, no voice, no narration, no dialogue, no music.
caption:
Café das 17h que vira jantar das 19h: o teste supremo de uma cozinha resolvida.

Quando a semana tá planejada, visita inesperada é alegria — não pânico.

Manda pra amiga que sempre fica pro jantar 👇
